glosses: To disinfect, purify, or rid of vermin with the fumes of certain chemicals.

examples.text: They fumigated the Church with burnt wool and feathers instead of incense, put foul water into the holy-water basins, and celebrated a parody on the Church-service, the mock Abbot officiating at the altar; […]
‘Pest control are coming too. They’ll be fumigating the place.’

glosses: Emplear humo, vapor o gas para limpiar o desinfectar un espacio, ambiente o territorio.
Dispersar humo, vapor, gas o algún químico en el aire con el fin de combatir plagas, insectos, etc.
